reviewType: independent runtime/collector delayed-state design review; not implementation QA

ownership.assessment: 166 literal unique paths; every concrete affected production/test path identified by this review is reserved. No ownership blocker.

findings.title: Do not reinterpret browser timeoutSeconds as model-plus-human wall time

sourceEvidence.section: 4: initialize before first NEXT_ACTION; explicitly charges model/clarification

sourceEvidence.fact: Used as the browser-operation default timeout.
Observed replay starts its source-step clock at actual step execution; there is no LLM/human phase inside it.
Existing model call budget defaults60 seconds and accepts up to600.
Actual model deadline is callSeconds bounded by session expiry.
Clarification uses existing question/session expiry and exact identity, not a30-second browser step clock.

findings.impact: A valid35-second model call or a human answer after30 seconds can newly fail a default-config session although no browser acquisition budget was spent. A1-second configured browser timeout would make ordinary model-backed authoring effectively unusable. This is a new learning timeout policy, not merely passive waiting or recovery fencing; calling it deliberately bounded does not establish source-backed compatibility.
findings.requiredCorrection: Keep model call, human clarification and hard session/lease budgets independent. Recommended minimal correction: use the locked timeoutSeconds as one cumulative passive-readiness allowance per source step, preserved across obligations/replans/clarifications/restarts, and charge only claimed readiness wait/collection windows. Persist remaining/charged duration plus an original per-window deadline bounded by the session expiry; normal model/clarification time outside a pending readiness window consumes its existing separate budgets, not this new allowance. A pending window remains charged across a crash/owner loss/clarification until its durable settlement, so pausing cannot refund unknown time or reset counters. Alternatively retain the existing session deadline plus explicit extra-poll caps without imposing a new configuration-derived global learning clock. In either choice document the exact durable fields, charging/settlement and send-claim check; do not alter replay’s already-approved monotonic source-step deadline.
oracles: With timeoutSeconds1 and a valid model call taking longer than1 second but less than callSeconds, an immediately ready target must not fail solely due to model latency.
Human clarification longer than browser timeout but within existing question/session expiry resumes exact chosen-reference mapping; it does not reset prior readiness usage/poll counters.
Two readiness episodes in one compound source step share one cumulative allowance; crash or an unresolved pending refresh cannot obtain a fresh allowance.
Existing model timeout/session expiry and current owner/source checks still stop as before.

findings.title: Clarify private probe freshness reads rather than promising an impossible zero-read freshness check

sourceEvidence.section: 1: probe performs no second traversal/value read; 2: must check existing freshness inventories

sourceEvidence.fact: Existing matches freshness checks call snapshotField on retained controls; this rereads field.value/selectedOptions and compares private signatures. DOM property changes need not emit mutation records.
eligibleSource/resolveReadPolicy currently fuse visibility with denial; resolveReadPolicy may inspect businessText and refuses hidden sources.

findings.impact: Implementers cannot literally reuse all existing freshness checks while also doing no second value read. Omitting field freshness without changing the stated READY/current-inventory guarantee is also not the specified contract. This ambiguity matters precisely for hostile value/property changes between observation and probe.
findings.requiredCorrection: State the small concrete rule: the probe performs no second DOM discovery or business capture and no new raw-text/value source read, but may perform the already-approved bounded private field/style-signature freshness checks on the last collection’s retained inventory; those bytes stay private and are not binding captures. Cache readiness/name/type/hard-denial/visibility/policy facts during that existing bounded collection, and evaluate the probe from those records plus the explicit permitted freshness checks. Hidden names/grants that cannot be proved from existing safe facts remain REFUSED. Keep final matches/validateInvocation immediately before one invocation. If instead the architect chooses a strictly metadata-only probe, explicitly make READY provisional with the full field freshness deferred to the existing final matches, and narrow the probe’s current-inventory claim accordingly; choose one behavior before implementation.
oracles: Direct element.value mutation without input/change/attribute mutation cannot result in invocation using a stale private inventory.
A hidden labelled non-read target with provable structural facts can be VISIBILITY_PENDING; a hidden label/text/grant requiring a new sensitive read remains REFUSED.
Probe calls never capture a binding, traverse a new subtree, expose hidden metadata or alter public observation bytes.

acceptedDesign.DELAY_001: Acquisition loops only before READY/invocation, preserves exact frozen locator/operation/guard, and does not retry capture/assert/submit. This closes the identified replay sampling gap once implemented.
acceptedDesign.DELAY_002: InvocationControl/check/beginInvocation/poison is a viable narrow local seam. Capturing one absolute monotonic source-step deadline and checking after every await resolves late Promise.race continuation risk; no public IPC change is needed.
acceptedDesign.DELAY_003: The conservative four-state classification is implementable through new private cached facts in the existing collector. Complete absence must be established from the bounded exact locator universe, not public nodes or coverage.complete. Unknown/unsupported/truncated/hidden competitor conditions never certify absence. The source does not provide those detailed cached reasons today, so the reserved collector refactor is real work, not an already-existing API.
acceptedDesign.DELAY_004: Using existing REFRESH/NEXT, real correlated /observe and owning-worker committed callbacks is viable. Existing V32 continuation check remains unchanged. Provider500 is not WAIT; model response schema remains unchanged. Timing blocker above must be corrected.
acceptedDesign.ownership: All required collector/runtime/backend/test seams are in the166-path File List. Type-only Guard/ReplayAction imports can describe the local probe without a runtime executor/model dependency in the stringified isolated collector.
acceptedDesign.compatibility: Preserving exported observation shapes, frozen artifact/operation/binding hashes and legacy behavior is coherent. Rebuild actual source/dist/catalog identities after implementation; this review grants no authority to change frozen bytes.

mandatoryImplementationConditions.condition: Cache all reasons needed by ABSENT/VISIBILITY_PENDING during the same bounded collection. A missing safe name is not evidence of non-match. Exclude unrelated hard-denied surfaces only from already available safe structural identity (including main-document scope); unresolved possible matches refuse.

Do not infer a historic native subtype beyond stored Guard.controlType/elementType. Apply only original frozen facts plus existing operation-specific live compatibility, preserving legitimate actionable=false div click/hover. READY must return one exported node from the request document/generation; replacement or mutation after READY is terminal.

Reserve count and32768-byte allowance before each collection, settle once to actual export bytes, retain unknown reservations. Enforce32 extra/source step,200 extra/run,400 total and13,107,200 bytes alongside50ms/4096-elements/depth64 and outgoing500/depth8/32768. Learning keeps its stricter existing400/1MiB session ceilings. No retained observation history is added to replay.

Make the guided nextPollAt formula explicit too: inherit100ms before first additional refresh and250ms thereafter (or another expressly frozen value), rather than leaving guided cadence implicit in scanner frequency. Returning safe202 when not due performs no model/runner I/O or counter increment.

Existing GuidedTranslationService.refresh currently re-reads current generation and synthesizes refresh-<generation>. Pending recovery must instead reuse the persisted refreshKey and expectedGeneration/exact request, including after callback committed before the second readiness transaction. Use the existing session command/observation-refresh intent record as the full request anchor; do not reconstruct from an advanced current generation. Clear pending only after exact correlated committed evidence; unrelated newer observations never roll progress backward or refund a poll.

Recover unresolved action/admission/outcome before any readiness poll. With concurrent scanners a single persisted pending reservation wins; another may recover that same idempotent refresh only. Source/config/plan/obligation/worker/fence changes reject stale completion. Preserve committed budget/late-usage settlement before outward refusal.

Control poisoning must synchronously precede timeout/cancel rejection. Retained work returning after poison cannot enter beginInvocation, withhold/insert a binding or emit PASS. Native dispatch remains non-atomic; once INVOKING is reached, uncertainty never reacquires/repeats the primitive.

Preserve public observation privacy byte equivalence and model/IPC shape. The new acquisition DTO is process-local only. New helpers inside installObservationCollector must remain closure-free fixed code; no imported runtime helper, arbitrary page program or DOM marker bridge.

requiredOracles006: Preserve the original failed asynchronous evidence and synchronous smoke. Add the genuine async-after-real-receipt confirmation with a barrier proving an actual post-submit missing-target collection before response release/render.

Guided flow: one submit and one independent receipt, no NEXT_ACTION sent for absent Confirmation, later actual owning-worker observation/preparation/admission on the revealed/appended node, unchanged semantic obligations and one SOURCE_PLAN.

Finalization/retry emits zero browser actions/model calls; two ordinary recorded replays keep identical artifact and recapture distinct fresh values, exactly one independent submit each, zero both LLM gateways.
Never appears, count/byte cap, compound-step shared budget, cancellation/timeout during each awaited collection/probe/matches/validate/withhold boundary, late returns and post-invocation uncertainty.

Duplicate including hidden competitor, missing/unresolved names, direct value-property change, sensitive ancestry/descendants/label sources, wrong origin/type/classification/read policy and post-acquisition replacement all refuse without semantic repair.

Actual PostgreSQL restart before/after refresh intent/callback and concurrent scanner/lease renewal preserve same pending key/count and corrected readiness-time accounting. Model/human-delay regression tests above are mandatory.
notRequiredBy006: No new live model accuracy corpus, production account provider, pilot, or broad latency benchmark; those remain later stories. The controlled asynchronous correctness proof is already006, not deferred009.
